subject: Re: BrightCart - Marketplace private offer & unit price mapping
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Grant <sofia@brightcart.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@brightcart.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace Sales <aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0000
Subject: BrightCart - Marketplace private offer & unit price mapping

Hi Sofia / BrightCart procurement team,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the candid view on your cost targets. Quick recap from our side and a few follow-ups so we can map to the AWS/GCP/Azure private offer flows: 

Call summary (short):
- Workload: customer support summarization + search enhancement across web + mobile apps.
- Expected monthly usage: ~2.5B tokens initially, scaling to 8–10B in 12 months (see attached usage estimates).
- Key constraint: target unit economics at or below $0.80 / 1M tokens on marketplace private offers after marketplace fees.
- Decision drivers: predictability (private offers + reserved units) and compliance controls (VPC + audit logs).

Action items I promised:
1) Share unit-price mapping template so we can model how Redwood's billed unit maps to marketplace SKU/unit pricing. Attached: redwood_marketplace_price_map.xlsx
2) Confirm BrightCart target $/1M tokens and preferred commitment term (1yr vs 3yr).
3) Connect you with AWS/GCP marketplace contacts if you want direct marketplace pricing guidance.

Can you confirm the target $/1M tokens (you mentioned $0.75–0.90 on the call) and whether BrightCart prefers a 12- or 36-month private offer? With those numbers Rafael and I will produce a model showing gross marketplace price vs Redwood net revenue.

Attachments: BrightCart_usage_estimates.xlsx (your usage sheet), redwood_marketplace_price_map.xlsx (template)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Sofia Grant <sofia@brightcart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@brightcart.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:20:00 -0000
Subject: Re: BrightCart - Marketplace private offer & unit price mapping

Thanks Marissa — good summary. Confirming numbers from our side: 

- Initial monthly tokens: 2.0–3.0B (pilot window)
- Target steady-state (12mo): 8B tokens/month
- Budget envelope for inference (public cloud marketplace spend): $6k–$7k / month during pilot, target $45k–$60k / month at steady state (we're budgeting conservative commit).
- Target marketplace unit price: ideally <= $0.80 / 1M tokens gross (including marketplace fees). If marketplace fees push us above $0.90 we need to revisit commitment/term.

Procurement: we prefer a 12-month committed private offer initially, with option to extend to 36 months contingent on price and performance. We'll share a finalized usage forecast Monday.

Two asks: can you (1) map Redwood's per-token billing to the marketplace SKU line (per 1M tokens) and (2) show model with two scenarios: (a) 12mo private offer at target $0.80 /1M, (b) 36mo deeper discount to reach ~$0.65 /1M net to BrightCart?

Thanks,
Sofia Grant
Head of Product 
BrightCart
sofia@brightcart.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Grant <sofia@brightcart.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Sales <aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com>, GCP Marketplace Rep <gcp-partner@google.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:10:00 -0000
Subject: Re: BrightCart - Marketplace private offer & unit price mapping

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clarity. I put together a first-pass mapping and a couple of notes (attached): redwood_marketplace_price_map.xlsx. High-level: 

- Redwood billable unit: per 1M input+output tokens (we use combined tokens). The marketplace wants a price per 1M tokens SKU to list in a private offer.
- Marketplace fees: AWS typically takes a cut on top of the listed price (varies by agreement). For modeling we used a 12% marketplace fee for AWS, 10% for GCP, and 8% for Azure (these are placeholders — marketplace reps in cc can confirm).
- To land BrightCart at $0.80 /1M gross (what you pay), Redwood gross must be lower to account for marketplace fees. Example: if AWS fee=12%, Redwood needs to receive ~ $0.71 /1M (since $0.71 / (1 - 0.12) ≈ $0.80).
- Reserved/commit terms: a 36-month commitment can unlock additional discounts on Redwood's side and potentially on marketplace fees/credits; we'll model both 12mo and 36mo.

Attached sheet includes: per-cloud gross price required, Redwood net, marketplace fee assumptions, and a sensitivity table for token volumes up to 10B/mo. I've also added a scenario showing token-bundled committed units (e.g., commit to 1M token bundles x N) which is how most private offers structure the SKU.

Next steps: Rafael + Marissa to update the sheet with BrightCart's finalized forecast (Sofia to send Monday). Marketplace reps — can you confirm typical fee % for private offers and any promo/credits for committed spend?

Rafael
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
From: AWS Marketplace Sales <aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Grant <sofia@brightcart.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0000
Subject: Re: BrightCart - Marketplace private offer & unit price mapping

Hi all — quick note from AWS Marketplace:

- Fee structure depends on program; for private offers with committed spend we can often reduce the standard take. Typical starting point is ~12%, but with committed annualized spend at BrightCart's expected steady-state we can consider 6–9% or marketplace credits.
- We can also provide promotional credits for new listings or co-marketing if the deal meets program thresholds.
- I'll loop in our partner specialist to draft sample private offer terms; need rough monthly spend and preferred term to do concrete modeling.

Best,
Chris Hale
AWS Marketplace Sales
aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com

Subject: Re: BrightCart - Marketplace private offer & unit price mapping

Perfect — thanks Chris and Rafael. Sofia — following up with the concrete deliverables: 

1) Rafael and I will produce two price models (attached) by EOD Tuesday showing:
   - Scenario A: 12mo private offer, target $0.80 /1M gross (AWS fee assumed 12% baseline)
   - Scenario B: 36mo private offer, target ~$0.65 /1M net to BrightCart (shows Redwood gross and marketplace fee sensitivity)

2) We'll also add a committed-bundle layout (e.g., X 1M-token bundles per month) so procurement can see contract language that maps to marketplace SKUs.

3) Please send the finalized usage forecast when ready (Sofia). Once we have it we'll produce exact monthly cost tables and a recommended private-offer price to send to AWS/GCP.

If procurement prefers, we can set a quick 20-minute call with the marketplace partner specialist to accelerate getting a formal private offer draft.

Thanks — will attach the modeled sheets in the next email.

Marissa
